reason: The analyst's estimate (0.627, SE 0.22) is close to my fully adjusted estimate (0.579, SE 0.23), and both show a modest positive effect. The analyst correctly left out the post-treatment mgmt_rating_2023. The weaknesses are that only one specification was run, there is no lagged productivity or other pre-period controls, and the outcome was trimmed without justification. The report also has no caveat about causality. These do not change the sign or rough size of the result. I could not re-run the code, so my comparison relies on the numbers in the reports.
